notes: §1985:XI.2.3.2 prints the sort-merge file control entry as SELECT file-name-1 ASSIGN TO {implementor-name-1 | literal-1} ... . and nothing else (§1985:XI.2.3.3 SR2: 'only the ASSIGN clause is permitted to follow file-name-1'). The compiler parses one fileControlClauseGroup for every file, requires ASSIGN (FileControlKeyRules.RequiredClauses, COBOL5701), screens literal-1 (AssignTargetRule.Resolve, COBOL2645) and refuses the clauses outside §2023:12.4.5.1 Format 4 for an SD file (FileControlKeyRules.Rules row SR-12.4.5.2-13 over EntryClauses, COBOL1900), with no 85 arm. Probed at 85 (classes b, c, e): ASSIGN TO 'SORTWK' (the witness), ASSIGN TO SORTWK and ASSIGN SORTWK sort and print AAA/CCC; no ASSIGN COBOL5701, ASSIGN TO. COBOL0312, ASSIGN twice COBOL2423, ASSIGN USING and TO ... USING COBOL0900, FILE STATUS, ACCESS MODE, RESERVE and ORGANIZATION RELATIVE COBOL1900, SORT STATUS COBOL1970, SPACE and N'..' COBOL2645, X'41' COBOL0900, 123 COBOL5506, three ASSIGN operands COBOL2256 (the implementor's list determination). THE DEFECT: the Format 4 screen is the 2023 one at every edition, so at 85 it admits what 2023 Format 4 adds and 1985 does not print: SELECT OPTIONAL SF and ASSIGN ... ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL (and the bare SEQUENTIAL) compile and run; and PADDING CHARACTER, a 1985 Sequential I-O clause that no 2023 table row knows, is also accepted on an SD file at 85. kb/Work PB5071 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-44.json).

next.reason: 1985 sort-merge file control: 'SELECT file-name-1 ASSIGN TO {implementor-name-1|literal-1} ... .', and 1985 SR XI.2.3.3-2 permits only ASSIGN after file-name-1. §2023:12.4.5.1 Format 4 (sort-merge), required for sort-merge files by §2023:12.4.5.2 SR13, keeps ASSIGN TO {device-name-1|literal-1} ... (meaning implementor-defined, §2023:12.4.5.2 SR5; literal-1 alphanumeric, not figurative, §2023:12.4.5.2 SR4) but adds '[USING data-name-1]', the alternative 'ASSIGN USING data-name-1', and '[[ORGANIZATION IS] SEQUENTIAL]'. More entries accepted; 1985 entries keep their meaning. CHANGED (looser). Note: the catalog text of FMT-12.4.5.1 stops after Format 2; Format 4 was read from specs/ISO_COBOL_2023.md.
